title: fix(core): a scoped import lookup miss names the scoping column when the value exists outside the scope
body:
Fixes #36159
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：导入数据时，如果某个查找列的值只存在于另一个上级记录下（例如合同属于另一个客户），被拒的那一行提示现在会写明是按哪一列、哪个值限定的，例如「合同：未找到匹配“CTR-0006”的记录（客户 = "Acme"）」；真的不存在的值，提示不变。
- 为什么做：替用 CSV 批量导入订单、合同的用户解决；以前这种行只提示“找不到记录”，导入的人去搜却能搜到，误以为系统出错。
- 出错会怎样：只改提示文字，拒绝与否和错误代码都不变；最坏是提示多一段或少一段说明，可以直接撤回本次合并。
- 无。

## What changes

`packages/core/src/utils/import-coerce.ts`. A lookup cell scoped by the row (the field's `dependsOn` column, or the master the target's `master_detail` field points at) used to answer every miss with `import_reference_not_found`: `Contract: no record matches "CTR-0006"`, also when CTR-0006 exists under another account.

After a scoped miss, `referenceNotFound` asks the same `resolveRef` once more without the scope. When that finds a record (one or several), the scope is why nothing matched, and the message adds the scoping columns and the cells the row gave them:

```
Contract: no record matches "CTR-0006" (Account = "UI Probe X Co")
```

A value that matches nothing at all keeps the plain sentence. Single-value and multi-value cells use the same path.

Per the seat's routing in the claim (`Ruling-ref:`): the reason stays `reference_not_found`, the code stays `import_reference_not_found`, no new enum value, no new catalog key. The extra part is built in core from the column label, the cell and punctuation only. It reads the same under every locale the catalog sentence is rendered in, and nothing in `packages/spec` changes.

The exported signatures do not change. `coerceFieldValue(raw, meta, ctx, scope)` now calls an internal `coerceCell`, which also takes the scoping columns (`ScopedBy`, not exported). Only `coerceRow` knows those columns and passes them. An outside caller of `coerceFieldValue` with a scope gets the plain sentence, as before.

Mechanism assumptions, measured:

- The probe runs as the importer. `runImport`'s resolver sends every lookup through `p.findData(findArgsBase(...))`, which carries the import's own `context`. The probe is the same resolver with no scope, so it finds only records the importer can already read by the same value, and the message says nothing about the record it found. A runner test pins this: rows hidden from the caller produce the plain sentence, and every read runs with the caller's context.
- `packages/spec/src/system/validation-message.ts` holds `import_reference_not_found` (line 164). That template is unchanged. The sentence is composed in core, so this needed no `needs_decision`.

## Tests

The pins go into the existing harness `import-runner-reference-master-scope.test.ts`, as a new top-level `describe`, so they use that file's engine-like `findData` fake. This follows AGENTS.md (ruling record 6583487846: a new pin for a component that already has a shared harness file goes into that file). The dispatch had preferred a new file named for the card.

- dependsOn-scoped cell naming another parent's record: `reference_not_found`, message `task: no record matches "Design review" (Project = "Gemini")`.
- master-scoped cell naming another master's detail, by name and by pasted id: same shape, naming `Contract`.
- a value that matches no record anywhere: the plain `no record matches` sentence, for both scope routes.
- multi-value cell: the out-of-scope token gets the qualified sentence, and a truly missing token gets the plain one.
- the probe runs as the caller: a record the caller's reads cannot see stays unnamed, the unscoped probe read did happen, and every read ran with the caller's context.

## Acceptance notes

- The added part is locale-neutral by design (label, cell, `=`, quotes). A fully translated sentence, like the card's example `"CTR-0006" belongs to another Account`, would need a new catalog key in `packages/spec`, which is published surface. That is outside this dispatch and outside the seat's routing.
- The probe adds one lookup per scoped miss. A scoped hit costs nothing extra. An unscoped verdict that is a hit is cached by the resolver, as before.
- A caller who cannot read the scoping field on the target (the narrowing that came with the scope) also gets the qualified sentence when the unscoped lookup finds the record. That is true: the row's scope is why the cell did not resolve.

## Verification

Two minutes: in the worktree, run `pnpm --filter @objectstack/core exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/utils/import-runner-reference-master-scope.test.ts`. Expect 15 passed, including the five `[#36159]` cases.

Read first, by risk:

1. `packages/core/src/utils/import-coerce.ts`, `referenceNotFound`: the probe and the message.
2. `packages/core/src/utils/import-coerce.ts`, `coerceRow`'s scope loop: where `ScopedBy` is built from the source column's label and raw cell.
3. `packages/core/src/utils/import-runner-reference-master-scope.test.ts`, the new `describe`.
